tasks.title: T19-US-001: DuckDB analytical index over the TSVs
tasks.description:
As a developer, I want a runtime analytical index so heavy tabular/faceted queries are fast, complementing the Neo4j graph store.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Add a runtime DuckDB (or SQLite) index built over lexicons/*.tsv at startup for complex tabular/aggregate queries; TSV remains the source of truth
- Route heavy tabular queries (faceting, aggregates) through the index; graph/correlation queries continue to use Neo4j (tasklist 16)
- Index rebuilds are incremental and documented; no change to the TSV write path
- vitest tests cover query parity between index and in-memory results; `npm run check` passes

tasks.description:

- Responses are bounded and paginated; whole-FeatureCollection responses are no longer required for large layers
- vitest tests cover bbox filtering; `npm run check` passes
